Context: Major Penalties.-

The Inquiry Officer shall strictly follow the procedures laid down in Rule 14 (18) before closing the Inquiry. Rule 8 of CCS (Pension) Rules also states that the departmental proceedings initiated against a Government servant shall be continued and concluded by the same authority which commenced them. GID (24), Rule 14.  
9. Defence may be in writing or oral. Oral defence will be recorded, got signed and a copy supplied to the Presenting Officer.
